text: 中国人民银行新闻发言人、副行长邹澜15日在国新办新闻发布会上表示，下一步，人民银行将继续平稳有序推动货币政策操作框架的改革完善，更好引导市场隔夜利率在政策利率附近平稳运行；结合一级交易商需求，研究逐步增加隔夜逆回购的操作频率，并和市场做好沟通。（新华财经）
text_en: PBOC spokesperson and Deputy Governor Zou Lan said at a State Council Information Office press conference on the 15th that next, the central bank will smoothly and orderly promote reform and improvement of the monetary policy operational framework, better guide overnight market rates to run steadily near the policy rate, and study gradually increasing the frequency of overnight reverse repo operations based on primary dealer demand, while communicating with the market. (Xinhua Finance)
